sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the Appellant fairly submits that the delay has been caused by her office.
Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that although the matter is connected with three other matters, four separate appeals had to be drafted which took some additional time.
Learned Counsel submits that the clients may not be made to suffer for the delay caused by her office.
8. Accordingly, for the reasons as stated above and for the reasons as stated in the Application, the delay is condoned.
9. The Application stands disposed of.

The present Appeal has been filed on behalf of the Appellant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 impugning the judgment and award dated 28.09.2024 [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"] passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT-01 (SE), Saket Courts, New Delhi.
By the Impugned Order, compensation in the sum of Rs.1,07,40,700/- has been awarded along with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum.
11. Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that the challenge in the present Appeal is on three grounds.

Firstly, that the vehicle (which for the purposes of this matter is called Vehicle B), which was the insured vehicle, was not directly involved in the accident, in as much as, it did not touch the vehicle of the deceased.
Secondly, that it is not a case of composite negligence and negligence could not be attributed to Vehicle B. 11.1
Lastly, the challenge is made to the quantum awarded.
It is the case of the Appellant that the learned Tribunal was required to take the last drawn salary which was Rs.47,000/-, however, the learned Tribunal has taken the

13. Subject to the deposit of entire decretal amount inclusive of up-to-date interest within a period of 6 weeks, the operation of the Impugned Award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
